description: Save one to five self-contained facts the user stated or confirmed. Oort skips secrets and dedupes, reinforces or supersedes older facts; a superseded fact stays in history.

items.description: One standalone claim, true without the conversation around it

place.description: Where the facts are: a place path, map coordinates, or both

node_id.description: A place path, root first, whole segments: site:hq/room:B/shelf:B3

radius.description: The size of the place, in metres

type.description: A hint for the kind of fact; Oort decides the final type

visibility.description: private (the default), or a Constellation to suggest sharing the fact with

name: remember
title: Remember facts
